content.title: How to watch High Point vs. Wisconsin men’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 19
content.text: An opening-round NCAA Tournament matchup will see the 12th-seeded High Point Panthers (30-4) take the court against the No. 5 seed Wisconsin Badgers (24-10) on Thursday at Moda Center. The contest tips off at 1:50 p.m. ET, on TBS.How to watch High Point Panthers vs. Wisconsin Badgers Venue: Moda Center Time: 1:50 p.m. ET TV: TBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. High Point vs. Wisconsin odds Spread: Wisconsin -10.5 (-113), High Point +10.5 (-107) Favorite Moneyline: Wisconsin -599 Underdog Moneyline: High Point +407 Total: 162.5 Total Over Odds: -109 Total Under Odds: -111 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Wisconsin is outscoring opponents by 7.1 points per game with a +241 scoring differential overall. It puts up 83.0 points per game (35th in college basketball) and gives up 75.9 per contest (237th in college basketball). Wisconsin hits 11.8 three-pointers per game (fourth-most in college basketball) while shooting 36.1% from deep (54th in college basketball). It is making 3.7 more threes per contest than its opponents, who drain 8.1 per game while shooting 33.3%. High Point has a +670 scoring differential, topping opponents by 19.7 points per game. It is putting up 90.0 points per game, third in college basketball, and is allowing 70.3 per contest to rank 78th in college basketball. High Point connects on 9.2 three-pointers per game (77th in college basketball) while shooting 35.6% from deep (86th in college basketball). It is making 1.8 more threes than its opponents, who drain 7.4 per game at 31.7%.
